result.summary: The page is mostly intact. One real defect: the Tokumaru Ramen title is clipped so its last letter renders incorrectly. The partially visible carousel items, filter chips, and bottom pizza card are expected scroll behavior and are not reported.

issues.description: The restaurant title in the 'Popular right now' card reads 'Tokumaru Rameı' instead of 'Tokumaru Ramen'. The final 'n' is cut off mid-glyph and looks like a dotless 'ı'. This card is full width and not at the screen edge, so the text container is clipping the name even though there is room for it.
issues.suggestion: Fix the title container's width or overflow settings so the full name renders. For example, remove the fixed width or overflow:hidden on the title, or let it flex to fill the space left of the rating. If truncation is needed, use a proper ellipsis rather than a hard clip.
